Encord: This document reflects our changes against the last version of the
POC Agreement received from Encord. By way of context: we have accepted the
vast majority of your proposed terms. This was done in recognition of the
fact that Encord is providing the POC at no charge, and many of the
concessions reflected herein would not be acceptable in a production
agreement. We have made an exception in this instance for that reason alone.

We have intentionally omitted Exhibits B and C from this markup. The
versions we received contained formatting issues that rendered both
exhibits largely unintelligible, and we did not want to inadvertently
introduce errors by attempting to reconstruct them.

On the subject of Exhibit C (the DPA): given the involvement of personal
data, we have very limited flexibility on that exhibit. If Encord requires
changes to the DPA, please do one of the following: (1) provide a
bullet-point summary of the specific changes requested, or (2) provide a
redline in Microsoft Word with explanatory comments accompanying each
proposed change.

Finally, please do not use third-party applications such as Apple Pages to
mark up our documents. Such applications frequently strip or alter
formatting in ways that require time-consuming reconstruction on our end.
If Encord requires the document in a different format, please let us know
and we will accommodate that request where possible.

Thank you,

Ciara Aguilar

subject: Re: Encord - Interest

No I didnt see that, must have gone into my junk folder! We are a small team- there'll be 3 of us working on the data labelling side of things.

We have started the project in so far as we've started to define the data, collect it etc. We will probably start actually labelling in the next couple of weeks. We are doing a CoSTAR advanced production technology grant project. The aim is to make a product that helps with level design in video games. The data we will be labelling is things like 2D game maps, video of playthroughs and text/images of playthroughs.

We'd definitely like to test the tool before buying, and its important that we can define our own labels in the tool (but I expect most people want to do that).

Best, Robbie

subject: RE: Encord - order form + terms to review
text:
Dear James,

After reviewing your proposed MSA there are several areas which are not compatible with Ambu’s position. I will need to allocate a resource from Ambu’s legal to deep dive and give a closer look at the key discrepancies. For the time being I can highlight as below, until legal will engage further.

Your proposed MSA is a supplier‑centric SaaS template and is not compatible with Ambu’s Cloud Service contractual model. There are multiple deviations relate to data protection, liability, service continuity, auditability, termination rights, and acceptance, which are core risk‑control mechanisms for Ambu and cannot be accepted as drafted.

Below are some of the areas I have idenfitied

SLA

I could not locate any Service Level Agreements, are these part of a separate appendix? As a minimum we need guaranteed uptime, RPO/RTO, service credits, termination for delay.

Changes to services

We require a fair notice of changes; Ambu needs termination right if change is unacceptable. Impact: Regulatory and operational risk

Data protection & security

As proposed this is an unacceptable exposure for Ambu - Supplier must be fully responsible for security, backup, access control; uncapped liability for data protection breaches.

Audit rights

Current proposal: No audit or assurance rights.
Ambu: Audit rights incl. SOC/ISAE reports and on‑site audits.
Impact: Non‑compliance with Ambu governance requirements

Termination & exit

Ambu requires Termination for convenience (3 months); mandatory exit and migration support.

Liability & indemnities
Ambu requires higher cap (contract value / EUR 500k); unlimited liability for IP, data protection, confidentiality

Data ownership

Ambu owns all Ambu Data; unrestricted access, export, exit assistance, and deletion

Kind regards,

Michele Lombardo | Strategic Procurement Manager
